items.title: Imposition of Minimum Export Price on export of Onions
items.what_changed: Listed by the source as DGFT notification 42/2023 (2023-24), DGFT. Official headline: “Imposition of Minimum Export Price on export of Onions”.
items.who_affected: Sector tags come only from words in that text: Exports & trade. A tag means the word appeared. It does not mean every firm in that sector is covered.
items.impact: The business effect cannot be read off the headline alone. Open the source before you change a price, a filing, or a shipment.
items.action: Open the official source linked on this page and check whether it changes anything you file, ship, price, or lend. This brief is a reading aid, not legal, tax, or investment advice.
